card.name: The verb result after may or can
card.fires_on: The verb "result" right after "may" or "can", as in "can result in", in warning statements about harm or poor outcomes. It also fires weakly on a few odd word pieces in other-language text.

modes.label: may/can result in
modes.description: The verb "result" after a modal verb, introducing a harmful consequence.
modes.example: Angioedema involving the tongue, glottis, or larynx, may<< result>> in airway obstruction.

modes.label: Foreign word pieces
modes.description: Partway through words in non-English text, such as a drug name or an Indonesian word.

card.writes: It pushes toward words like timeline and away from the noun "results", so the model does not continue with a noun after the verb.
card.plain: It marks the verb "result" in phrases like "can result in" that lead into a stated consequence.
